t: Signature Gazebo / Ignition Robotics: What Gazebo Is: The Robot's Proving Ground
title: Signature Gazebo / Ignition Robotics: What Gazebo Is: The Robot's Proving Ground
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigWorld twin, Manon's original synthetic-world design. SigWorld mirrors the physics-plus-sensors architecture but every world file carries a fidelity manifest — which sensors are modeled to what accuracy — so 'it worked in sim' always comes with the fine print of what the sim actually modeled.
key_facts: ROS 2 bridge: sim indistinguishable to the stack
